answer_1.quote: Text Style Transfer can be thought of as a form of Controllable Language Generation
answer_1.outputs: Style transferred sentences preserving content and fluency

answer_2.quote: Typically, metrics for style transfer include Style Transfer Accuracy (using a pretrained classifier), BLEU for content preservation, and perplexity (using a pretrained LM) to check the fluency of outputs.

answer_4.quote: Three volunteers were given the task of voting on 200 instances (equally split for the E to C and C to E task) from the test set. A vote consists of four options, i.e., "Model 1 better", "Model 2 better" or "Both Good", "Both Bad", where the models were randomised.
answer_4.guideline: Volunteers voted on which model output was better, or if both were good or bad, based on pairwise comparison.
